Scenario fixture: a11ycore-aria-checked-state-mismatch

Each target has a stable id of the form acsm_case_NN.

A. Valid

01 — PASS: checkbox checked, aria-checked="true" (matches)
02 — PASS: checkbox unchecked, aria-checked="false" (matches)
03 — PASS: radio checked, aria-checked="true" (matches)

B. Invalid (cantTell — see rule's implementation notes for why this is manual, not fail)

04 — CANTTELL: checkbox checked, aria-checked="false" (mismatch)
05 — CANTTELL: checkbox unchecked, aria-checked="true" (mismatch)
06 — CANTTELL: radio unchecked, aria-checked="true" (mismatch)
07 — CANTTELL: checkbox unchecked, aria-checked="mixed" — jsdom's static-parse .indeterminate is always false, no attribute reflects it (found via a real hydration pattern: server-rendered aria-checked="mixed" before client JS sets .indeterminate on load)
08 — CANTTELL: radio checked, aria-checked="mixed" — radio has no indeterminate state, so "mixed" always normalizes to "false" and mismatches an actually-checked radio

C. Not applicable (skipped, not counted)

09 — NEUTRAL: checkbox with no aria-checked at all (redundant-but-harmless native state, not this rule's concern)
10 — NEUTRAL: role="checkbox" on a non-native element (this rule is scoped to native <input> only)

End of fixture.
